D.t: Tim Kennedy leads by 31.8 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 84,833 votes; a one point swing is about 1,334 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +24.6 and D +39.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
